title: Lord Who Throughout These Forty Days
alsoKnownAs: O Lord, Throughout These Forty Days
description: Lord Who Throughout These Forty Days in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Claudia Frances Ibotson Hernaman, first published in 1873. The tune, ST. FLAVIAN, is from Day's Psalter, 1563. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Lord, who through-out these for-ty days For us didst fast and pray, Teach us with Thee to mourn our sins And close by Thee to stay.

lines: Lord, who throughout these forty days
For us didst fast and pray,
Teach us with Thee to mourn our sins
And close by Thee to stay.
As Thou with Satan didst contend,
And didst the vict'ry win,
O give us strength in Thee to fight,
In Thee to conquer sin.
As Thou didst hunger bear, and thirst,
So teach us, gracious Lord,
To die to self, and chiefly live
By Thy most holy Word.
And through these days of penitence,
And through Thy passiontide,
Yea, evermore in life and death,
Jesus, with us abide.
Abide with us, that so, this life
Of suff'ring over past,
An Easter of unending joy
We may attain at last.
